items.source: As of Spring Framework 7.0, by default it only decodes types annotated with @Serializable at type or generics level since it allows combined usage with other general purpose JSON decoders like JacksonJsonDecoder without conflicts.
items.translation: 自 Spring Framework 7.0 起，默认情况下仅解码在类型或泛型级别上标注了@Serializable的类型，因为它允许与其他通用 JSON 解码器（如JacksonJsonDecoder）结合使用而不会产生冲突。

items.source: Alternative constructors with a Predicate<ResolvableType> parameter can be used to customize this behavior. For example, new KotlinSerializationJsonDecoder(type -> true) will decode all types supported by Kotlin Serialization, including unannotated Kotlin enumerations, numbers, characters, booleans and strings.
items.translation: 带有 `Predicate<ResolvableType>` 参数的替代构造函数可用于自定义此行为。例如，`new KotlinSerializationJsonDecoder(type -> true)` 将解码 Kotlin Serialization 支持的所有类型，包括未注解的 Kotlin 枚举、数字、字符、布尔值和字符串。

items.source: Construct a new decoder using Json.Default instance which only decodes types annotated with @Serializable at type or generics level.
items.translation: 使用仅解码在类型或泛型级别上标注了 `@Serializable` 的类型的 `Json.Default` 实例来构建一个新的解码器。

items.source: Construct a new decoder using Json.Default instance which only decodes types for which the specified predicate returns true.
items.translation: 使用仅对指定谓词返回 `true` 的类型进行解码的 `Json.Default` 实例构建新的解码器。

items.source: Construct a new decoder using the provided Json instance which only decodes types annotated with @Serializable at type or generics level.
items.translation: 使用提供的 `Json` 实例构建一个新的解码器，该解码器仅解码在类型或泛型级别上标注了 `@Serializable` 的类型。

items.source: Construct a new decoder using the provided Json instance which only decodes types for which the specified predicate returns true.
items.translation: 使用提供的 `Json` 实例构建一个新的解码器，该解码器仅对指定谓词返回 `true` 的类型进行解码。

items.source: Decoding streams is not supported yet, see kotlinx.serialization/issues/1073 related issue.
items.translation: 尚未支持解码流，请参阅相关 issue kotlinx.serialization/issues/1073。
